主要内容: Novavax, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 8, 2018, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing includes an investor presentation and is signed by John A. Herrmann III, who holds the title of Senior Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary. The document outlines the company's strategic direction and key initiatives. The filing is part of the company's regular disclosure obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No specific financial or operational details are provided in the filing, but it reflects the company's ongoing communication with investors and regulatory authorities.
